conditions: Must be called before initializing the AppLovin SDK
effects: Used to comply with COPPA, GDPR and other age-related requirements, Apple App Store and Google Play Store policies. It sets if the user is in age restricted category i.e., under the age of 16 or defined by applicable laws. AppLovin does not knowingly collect personal information from children or serve ads to children. Apps designed exclusively for children or directed to children may not use AppLovin SDK. If a user is in an age-restricted category, AppLovin will not collect personal information from that user, nor will it serve advertisements to that user.

conditions: If the user is known to be in an age-restricted category
effects: User's consent is recorded and can be checked via Mediation Debugger or the “Privacy States” logs. AppLovin will stop collecting personal information from that user and stop serving advertisements to the user.

conditions: If the user is known not to be in an age-restricted category
effects: User's consent is recorded and can be checked via Mediation Debugger or the “Privacy States” logs. AppLovin will start collecting personal information from the user and serving advertisements.
